verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵילִ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ מִדְבַּר־ סִ֔ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּין־ אֵילִ֖ם וּבֵ֣ין סִינָ֑י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לְצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·’ê·lim way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- miḏ·bar- sîn ’ă·šer bên- ’ê·lim ū·ḇên sî·nāy ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî lə·ṣê·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the second month after they had left the land of Egypt the whole congregation . . . of Israel set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin which is between Elim . . . and Sinai
verses.literalPt: E PARTINDO de Elim, toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel veio ao deserto de Sim, que está entre Elim e Sinai, aos quinze dias do mês segundo, depois de sua saída da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּלִּינוּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·lī·nū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And there in the desert the whole congregation . . . of Israel grumbled against Moses . . . and Aaron
verses.literalPt: E toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e contra Arão no deserto.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵהֶ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֨ן מוּתֵ֤נוּ בְיַד־ יְהוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשִׁבְתֵּ֙נוּ֙ עַל־ סִ֣יר הַבָּשָׂ֔ר בְּאָכְלֵ֥נוּ לֶ֖חֶם לָשֹׂ֑בַע כִּֽי־ הוֹצֵאתֶ֤ם אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לְהָמִ֛ית אֶת־ כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֥ל הַזֶּ֖ה בָּרָעָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mî- yit·tên mū·ṯê·nū ḇə·yaḏ- Yah·weh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·šiḇ·tê·nū ‘al- sîr hab·bā·śār bə·’ā·ḵə·lê·nū le·ḥem lā·śō·ḇa‘ kî- hō·w·ṣê·ṯem ’ō·ṯā·nū ’el- ham·miḏ·bār haz·zeh lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- kāl- haq·qā·hāl haz·zeh bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: If only . . . we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt they said . . . . . . . . . There we sat by pots of meat and ate our fill of bread but you have brought us into this desert to starve this whole assembly to death
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel disseram-lhes: Quem dera tivéssemos morrido por mão do SENHOR na terra do Egito, quando estávamos sentados junto às panelas de carne, quando comíamos pão até fartar! Porque nos tendes trazido a este deserto, para matardes de fome a toda esta multidão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מַמְטִ֥יר לָכֶ֛ם לֶ֖חֶם מִן־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְיָצָ֨א הָעָ֤ם וְלָֽקְטוּ֙ דְּבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ לְמַ֧עַן אֲנַסֶּ֛נּוּ הֲיֵלֵ֥ךְ בְּתוֹרָתִ֖י אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh hin·nî mam·ṭîr lā·ḵem le·ḥem min- haš·šā·mā·yim wə·yā·ṣā hā·‘ām wə·lā·qə·ṭū də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw lə·ma·‘an ’ă·nas·sen·nū hă·yê·lêḵ bə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî ’im- lō
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Behold I will rain down bread from heaven for you Each day . . . the people are to go out and gather enough for that day In this way I will test whether or not they will follow My instructions
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Eis que vos farei chover pão dos céus, e o povo sairá, e colherá diariamente a porção para cada dia, para que eu o prove se anda em minha lei ou não.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י וְהֵכִ֖ינוּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ יָבִ֑יאוּ וְהָיָ֣ה מִשְׁנֶ֔ה עַ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִלְקְט֖וּ י֥וֹם׀ יֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm haš·šiš·šî wə·hê·ḵî·nū ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yā·ḇî·’ū wə·hā·yāh miš·neh ‘al ’ă·šer- yil·qə·ṭū yō·wm yō·wm
verses.literal: Then on the sixth day when they prepare what they bring in it will be twice as much as they gather on the other days . . .
verses.literalPt: E acontecerá, no sexto dia, que prepararão o que colherem; e será o dobro do que colhem cada dia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֶ֕רֶב וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘e·reḇ wî·ḏa‘·tem kî Yah·weh hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites . . . This evening you will know that it was the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Então disseram Moisés e Arão a todos os filhos de Israel: À tarde sabereis que o SENHOR vos tirou da terra do Egito,

verses.original: וּבֹ֗קֶר וּרְאִיתֶם֙ אֶת־ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁמְע֥וֹ אֶת־ תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶ֖ם עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְנַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה כִּ֥י תַלּוֹנוּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇō·qer ū·rə·’î·ṯem ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh bə·šā·mə·‘ōw ’eṯ- tə·lun·nō·ṯê·ḵem ‘al- Yah·weh wə·naḥ·nū māh kî ṯal·lō·nū ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: and in the morning you will see the LORD’s glory because He has heard your grumbling against Him For who are we that you should grumble against us
verses.literalPt: E amanhã vereis a glória do SENHOR, porquanto ouviu as vossas murmurações contra o SENHOR. E quem somos nós, para que murmureis contra nós?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּתֵ֣ת יְהוָה֩ לָכֶ֨ם בָּעֶ֜רֶב בָּשָׂ֣ר לֶאֱכֹ֗ל וְלֶ֤חֶם בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ לִשְׂבֹּ֔עַ בִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ תְּלֻנֹּ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עָלָ֑יו וְנַ֣חְנוּ מָ֔ה לֹא־ עָלֵ֥ינוּ תְלֻנֹּתֵיכֶ֖ם כִּ֥י עַל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh bə·ṯêṯ Yah·weh lā·ḵem bā·‘e·reḇ bā·śār le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·le·ḥem bab·bō·qer liś·bō·a‘ biš·mō·a‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- tə·lun·nō·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer- ’at·tem mal·lî·nim ‘ā·lāw wə·naḥ·nū māh lō- ‘ā·lê·nū ṯə·lun·nō·ṯê·ḵem kî ‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Moses added The LORD will give you meat to eat this evening and bread to fill you in the morning for He has heard your grumbling - against Him Who are we Your grumblings are not against us . . . but against the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Moisés: Isso será quando o SENHOR à tarde vos der carne para comer, e pela manhã pão a fartar, porquanto o SENHOR ouviu as vossas murmurações, com que murmurais contra ele. E quem somos nós? As vossas murmurações não são contra nós, mas sim contra o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֱמֹ֗ר אֶֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קִרְב֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע אֵ֖ת תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn ’ĕ·mōr ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl qir·ḇū lip̄·nê Yah·weh kî šā·ma‘ ’êṯ tə·lun·nō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Moses said to . . . Aaron Tell . . . the whole congregation . . . of Israel Come before the LORD for He has heard your grumbling
verses.literalPt: Depois disse Moisés a Arão: Dize a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel: Chegai-vos à presença do SENHOR, porque ouviu as vossas murmurações.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּדַבֵּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּפְנ֖וּ אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְהִנֵּה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה נִרְאָ֖ה בֶּעָנָֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḏab·bêr ’a·hă·rōn ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yip̄·nū ’el- ham·miḏ·bār wə·hin·nêh kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh nir·’āh be·‘ā·nān
verses.literal: And as Aaron was speaking to the whole congregation . . . of Israel they looked toward the desert and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, quando falou Arão a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e eles se viraram para o deserto, eis que a glória do SENHOR apareceu na nuvem.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶת־ תְּלוּנֹּת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ דַּבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר בֵּ֤ין הָֽעַרְבַּ֙יִם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ בָשָׂ֔ר וּבַבֹּ֖קֶר תִּשְׂבְּעוּ־ לָ֑חֶם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- tə·lūn·nōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl dab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem lê·mōr bên hā·‘ar·ba·yim tō·ḵə·lū ḇā·śār ū·ḇab·bō·qer tiś·bə·‘ū- lā·ḥem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites Tell them . . . . . . At twilight you will eat meat and in the morning you will be filled with bread Then you will know that I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Tenho ouvido as murmurações dos filhos de Israel. Fala-lhes, dizendo: Entre as duas tardes comereis carne, e pela manhã vos fartareis de pão; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בָעֶ֔רֶב וַתַּ֣עַל הַשְּׂלָ֔ו וַתְּכַ֖ס אֶת־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּבַבֹּ֗קֶר הָֽיְתָה֙ שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַטַּ֔ל סָבִ֖יב לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇā·‘e·reḇ wat·ta·‘al haś·śə·lāw wat·tə·ḵas ’eṯ- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ū·ḇab·bō·qer hā·yə·ṯāh šiḵ·ḇaṯ haṭ·ṭal sā·ḇîḇ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: That evening quail came and covered the camp and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que à tarde subiram codornizes, e cobriram o arraial; e pela manhã jazia o orvalho ao redor do arraial.

verses.original: וַתַּ֖עַל שִׁכְבַ֣ת הַטָּ֑ל וְהִנֵּ֞ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י הַמִּדְבָּר֙ דַּ֣ק מְחֻסְפָּ֔ס דַּ֥ק כַּכְּפֹ֖ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘al šiḵ·ḇaṯ haṭ·ṭāl wə·hin·nêh ‘al- pə·nê ham·miḏ·bār daq mə·ḥus·pās daq kak·kə·p̄ōr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: When the layer of dew had evaporated there were thin flakes on the desert floor as fine as frost on the ground
verses.literalPt: E quando o orvalho se levantou, eis que sobre a face do deserto estava uma coisa miúda, redonda, miúda como a geada sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִיו֙ מָ֣ן ה֔וּא כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ מַה־ ה֑וּא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם ה֣וּא הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw mān hū kî lō yā·ḏə·‘ū mah- hū way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’ă·lê·hem hū hal·le·ḥem ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh lā·ḵem lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: When the Israelites . . . saw it they asked one . . . another What is it For they did not know what it was So Moses told them It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat
verses.literalPt: E, vendo-a os filhos de Israel, disseram uns aos outros: Que é isto? Porque não sabiam o que era. Disse-lhes pois Moisés: Este é o pão que o SENHOR vos deu para comer.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לִקְט֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ אִ֖ישׁ לְפִ֣י אָכְל֑וֹ עֹ֣מֶר לַגֻּלְגֹּ֗לֶת מִסְפַּר֙ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאָהֳל֖וֹ תִּקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh liq·ṭū mim·men·nū ’îš lə·p̄î ’ā·ḵə·lōw ‘ō·mer lag·gul·gō·leṯ mis·par nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem ’îš la·’ă·šer bə·’ā·ho·lōw tiq·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: This . . . is what the LORD has commanded Each one is to gather as much as he needs You may take an omer for each . . . person . . . in your tent
verses.literalPt: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR tem mandado: Colhei dele cada um conforme ao que pode comer, um ômer por cabeça, segundo o número das vossas almas; cada um tomará para os que se acharem na sua tenda.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֖ן בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּלְקְט֔וּ הַמַּרְבֶּ֖ה וְהַמַּמְעִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yil·qə·ṭū ham·mar·beh wə·ham·mam·‘îṭ
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did this Some gathered more and some less
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram assim; e colheram, uns mais e outros menos.

verses.original: וַיָּמֹ֣דּוּ בָעֹ֔מֶר וְלֹ֤א הֶעְדִּיף֙ הַמַּרְבֶּ֔ה וְהַמַּמְעִ֖יט לֹ֣א הֶחְסִ֑יר אִ֥ישׁ לְפִֽי־ אָכְל֖וֹ לָקָֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·mōd·dū ḇā·‘ō·mer wə·lō he‘·dîp̄ ham·mar·beh wə·ham·mam·‘îṭ lō heḥ·sîr ’îš lə·p̄î- ’ā·ḵə·lōw lā·qā·ṭū
verses.literal: When they measured it by the omer he who gathered much had no excess and he who gathered little had no shortfall Each one gathered as much as he needed to eat
verses.literalPt: Porém, medindo-o com o ômer, não sobejava ao que colhera muito, nem faltava ao que colhera pouco; cada um colheu tanto quanto podia comer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֕ישׁ אַל־ יוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’ă·lê·hem ’îš ’al- yō·w·ṯêr mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: Then Moses said to them No one may keep any of it until morning
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Ninguém deixe dele para amanhã.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ שָׁמְע֣וּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיּוֹתִ֨רוּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עַד־ בֹּ֔קֶר וַיָּ֥רֻם תּוֹלָעִ֖ים וַיִּבְאַ֑שׁ וַיִּקְצֹ֥ף עֲלֵהֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- šā·mə·‘ū ’el- mō·šeh way·yō·w·ṯi·rū ’ă·nā·šîm mim·men·nū ‘aḏ- bō·qer way·yā·rum tō·w·lā·‘îm way·yiḇ·’aš way·yiq·ṣōp̄ ‘ă·lê·hem mō·šeh
verses.literal: But they did not listen to Moses some people left part of it until morning and it became infested with maggots and began to smell So Moses was angry with them
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, não deram ouvidos a Moisés, antes alguns deles deixaram dele para o dia seguinte; e criou bichos, e cheirava mal; por isso indignou-se Moisés contra eles.

verses.original: וַיִּלְקְט֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֣י אָכְל֑וֹ וְחַ֥ם הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְנָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·qə·ṭū ’ō·ṯōw bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer ’îš kə·p̄î ’ā·ḵə·lōw wə·ḥam haš·še·meš wə·nā·mās
verses.literal: Every morning . . . each one gathered as much as was needed and when the sun grew hot it melted away
verses.literalPt: Eles, pois, o colhiam cada manhã, cada um conforme ao que podia comer; porque, aquecendo o sol, derretia-se.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֗י לָֽקְט֥וּ לֶ֙חֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה שְׁנֵ֥י הָעֹ֖מֶר לָאֶחָ֑ד וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וַיַּגִּ֖ידוּ לְמֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šiš·šî lā·qə·ṭū le·ḥem miš·neh šə·nê hā·‘ō·mer lā·’e·ḥāḏ way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yag·gî·ḏū lə·mō·šeh
verses.literal: On the sixth day they gathered twice as much food two omers per person and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que ao sexto dia colheram pão em dobro, dois ômeres para cada um; e todos os príncipes da congregação vieram, e contaram-no a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁבָּת֧וֹן שַׁבַּת־ קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה מָחָ֑ר אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאפ֞וּ אֵפ֗וּ וְאֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ תְּבַשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּשֵּׁ֔לוּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֹדֵ֔ף הַנִּ֧יחוּ לָכֶ֛ם לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem hū ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh šab·bā·ṯō·wn šab·baṯ- qō·ḏeš Yah·weh mā·ḥār ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tō·p̄ū ’ê·p̄ū wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer- tə·ḇaš·šə·lū baš·šê·lū wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·‘ō·ḏêp̄ han·nî·ḥū lā·ḵem lə·miš·me·reṯ ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer
verses.literal: He told them . . . This is what the LORD has said Tomorrow is to be a day of complete rest a holy Sabbath to the LORD So bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil Then set aside whatever remains and keep it until morning
verses.literalPt: E ele disse-lhes: Isto é o que o SENHOR tem dito: Amanhã é repouso, o santo sábado do SENHOR; o que quiserdes cozer no forno, cozei-o, e o que quiserdes cozer em água, cozei-o em água; e tudo o que sobejar, guardai para vós até amanhã.

verses.original: וַיַּנִּ֤יחוּ אֹתוֹ֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְלֹ֣א הִבְאִ֔ישׁ וְרִמָּ֖ה לֹא־ הָ֥יְתָה בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yan·nî·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh wə·lō hiḇ·’îš wə·rim·māh lō- hā·yə·ṯāh bōw
verses.literal: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded and it did not smell or contain . . . any maggots
verses.literalPt: E guardaram-no até o dia seguinte, como Moisés tinha ordenado; e não cheirou mal nem nele houve algum bicho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אִכְלֻ֣הוּ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּֽי־ שַׁבָּ֥ת הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהוָ֑ה הַיּ֕וֹם לֹ֥א תִמְצָאֻ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’iḵ·lu·hū hay·yō·wm kî- šab·bāṯ hay·yō·wm Yah·weh hay·yō·wm lō ṯim·ṣā·’u·hū baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Eat it today . . . Moses said because today is a Sabbath to the LORD Today you will not find anything in the field
verses.literalPt: Então disse Moisés: Comei-o hoje, porquanto hoje é o sábado do SENHOR; hoje não o achareis no campo.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תִּלְקְטֻ֑הוּ וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י שַׁבָּ֖ת לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm til·qə·ṭu·hū ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šab·bāṯ lō yih·yeh- bōw
verses.literal: For six days you may gather but on the seventh day the Sabbath it will not be there . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Seis dias o colhereis, mas o sétimo dia é o sábado; nele não haverá.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י יָצְא֥וּ מִן־ הָעָ֖ם לִלְקֹ֑ט וְלֹ֖א מָצָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yā·ṣə·’ū min- hā·‘ām lil·qōṭ wə·lō mā·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather but they did not find anything
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu ao sétimo dia, que alguns do povo saíram para colher, mas não o acharam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה עַד־ אָ֙נָה֙ מֵֽאַנְתֶּ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתַ֖י וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh mê·’an·tem liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯay wə·ṯō·w·rō·ṯāy
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses How long . . . will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Até quando recusareis guardar os meus mandamentos e as minhas leis?

verses.original: רְא֗וּ כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֮ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֣ם הַשַּׁבָּת֒ עַל־ כֵּ֠ן ה֣וּא נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י לֶ֣חֶם יוֹמָ֑יִם שְׁב֣וּ׀ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֗יו אַל־ יֵ֥צֵא אִ֛ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū kî- Yah·weh nā·ṯan lā·ḵem haš·šab·bāṯ ‘al- kên hū nō·ṯên lā·ḵem bay·yō·wm haš·šiš·šî le·ḥem yō·w·mā·yim šə·ḇū ’îš taḥ·tāw ’al- yê·ṣê ’îš mim·mə·qō·mōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: Understand that the LORD has given you the Sabbath that is why . . . on the sixth day He will give you bread for two days On the seventh day everyone must stay where he is no one may leave his place
verses.literalPt: Vede, porquanto o SENHOR vos deu o sábado, portanto ele no sexto dia vos dá pão para dois dias; cada um fique no seu lugar, ninguém saia do seu lugar no sétimo dia.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבְּת֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bə·ṯū hā·‘ām bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇi·‘î
verses.literal: So the people rested on the seventh day
verses.literalPt: Assim repousou o povo no sétimo dia.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֧וּ בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ מָ֑ן וְה֗וּא כְּזֶ֤רַע גַּד֙ לָבָ֔ן וְטַעְמ֖וֹ כְּצַפִּיחִ֥ת בִּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- šə·mōw mān wə·hū kə·ze·ra‘ gaḏ lā·ḇān wə·ṭa‘·mōw kə·ṣap·pî·ḥiṯ biḏ·ḇāš
verses.literal: Now the house of Israel called the bread . . . manna It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey
verses.literalPt: E chamou a casa de Israel o seu nome maná; e era como semente de coentro branco, e o seu sabor como bolos de mel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה זֶ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה מְלֹ֤א הָעֹ֙מֶר֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן׀ יִרְא֣וּ אֶת־ הַלֶּ֗חֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱכַ֤לְתִּי אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh mə·lō hā·‘ō·mer mim·men·nū lə·miš·me·reṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem lə·ma·‘an yir·’ū ’eṯ- hal·le·ḥem ’ă·šer he·’ĕ·ḵal·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bam·miḏ·bār bə·hō·w·ṣî·’î ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Moses said This . . . is what the LORD . . . has commanded Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E disse Moisés: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR tem mandado: Encherás um ômer dele e guardá-lo-ás para as vossas gerações, para que vejam o pão que vos tenho dado a comer neste deserto, quando eu vos tirei da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֚ח צִנְצֶ֣נֶת אַחַ֔ת וְתֶן־ שָׁ֥מָּה מְלֹֽא־ הָעֹ֖מֶר מָ֑ן וְהַנַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ ṣin·ṣe·neṯ ’a·ḥaṯ wə·ṯen- šām·māh mə·lō- hā·‘ō·mer mān wə·han·naḥ ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·miš·me·reṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: So Moses . . . told Aaron Take a jar and fill it . . . . . . with an omer of manna Then place it before the LORD to be preserved for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Disse também Moisés a Arão: Toma um vaso, e põe nele um ômer cheio de maná, e coloca-o diante do SENHOR, para guardá-lo para as vossas gerações.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּנִּיחֵ֧הוּ אַהֲרֹ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדֻ֖ת לְמִשְׁמָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh way·yan·nî·ḥê·hū ’a·hă·rōn lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ lə·miš·mā·reṯ
verses.literal: And Aaron placed it in front of the Testimony to be preserved just as the LORD . . . had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Como o SENHOR tinha ordenado a Moisés, assim Arão o pôs diante do Testemunho, para ser guardado.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת־ הַמָּן֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה עַד־ בֹּאָ֖ם אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ נוֹשָׁ֑בֶת אֶת־ הַמָּן֙ אָֽכְל֔וּ עַד־ בֹּאָ֕ם אֶל־ קְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ham·mān ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ‘aḏ- bō·’ām ’el- ’e·reṣ nō·wō·šā·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- ham·mān ’ā·ḵə·lū ‘aḏ- bō·’ām ’el- qə·ṣêh ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . ate manna forty years until they came to a land where they could settle they ate manna until they reached . . . the border of Canaan
verses.literalPt: E comeram os filhos de Israel maná quarenta anos, até que entraram em terra habitada; comeram maná até que chegaram aos termos da terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וְהָעֹ֕מֶר עֲשִׂרִ֥ית הָאֵיפָ֖ה הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ō·mer ‘ă·śi·rîṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh hū
verses.literal: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah . . .
verses.literalPt: E um ômer é a décima parte do efa.
